paragraphs: Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. (individually, "Bancshares" and collectively with its subsidiaries including Live Oak Banking Company, the "Company," also referred to as "our" and "we"), headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina, is the bank holding company for Live Oak Banking Company (the "Bank" or "Live Oak Bank"). The Bank was incorporated in February 2008 as a North Carolina-chartered commercial bank and operates an established national online platform for small business lending and deposit gathering. Bancshares was incorporated under the laws of the state of North Carolina on December 18, 2008, for the purpose of serving as the bank holding company of Live Oak Bank. Bancshares completed its initial public offering ("IPO") in July 2015.

The Company predominantly originates loans partially guaranteed by the U.S. Small Business Administration (the "SBA") and to a lesser extent by the United States Department of Agriculture ("USDA") Rural Energy for America Program ("REAP"), Water and Environmental Program ("WEP"), Business & Industry ("B&I") and Community Facilities loan programs. These loans are to small businesses and professionals with what the Company believes are lower risk characteristics. Industries, or "verticals," on which the Company focuses its lending efforts are carefully selected. The Company also lends more broadly to select borrowers outside of those verticals.

In addition to focusing on industry verticals, the Company emphasizes developing detailed knowledge of its customers' businesses. This knowledge is developed, in part, through virtual and/or regular visits with customers, wherever they are located. These regular visits are designed to foster, both for the Company and for the customer, a deep and personalized experience throughout the lending relationship. The Company has developed, and continues to refine, a technology-based platform to facilitate providing financial services to the small business community on a national scale and has leveraged this technology to optimize the Company's loan origination process, customer experience, reporting metrics, and servicing activity. The Company services customers efficiently throughout the loan process and monitors their performance by means of the technology-based platform without maintaining traditional branch locations.

For additional information on the Company's business, financial performance and results of operations, see "Overview" and "Executive Summary" in Part II, Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of this Report.

The Company's voting common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange LLC (the "NYSE") under the symbol "LOB." As of January 31, 2026, there were 200 holders of record of the Company's voting common stock. The Company's depositary shares, each representing a 1/40th interest in a share of 8.375% fixed rate series A non-cumulative perpetual preferred stock, no par value per share (the "depositary shares") trade on the NYSE under the symbol "LOB/PA". The Company's principal executive office is located at 1741 Tiburon Drive, Wilmington, North Carolina 28403, telephone number (910) 790-5867. The Company maintains a website at www.liveoak.bank. Documents available on the website include: (i) the Company's Code of Ethics and Conflict of Interest Policy; (ii) charters for the Audit, Risk, Compensation, and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees of the Board of Directors, and (iii) the Company's Corporate Governance Guidelines. These documents also are available in print to any shareholder who requests a copy. Except as otherwise expressly stated in these documents, the information contained on our website or available by hyperlink from our website is not part of this Report and is not incorporated into this Report or any other documents we file with, or furnish to, the SEC.

In addition, available free of charge through the Company's website is the Annual Report on Form 10-K, Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q, Current Reports on Form 8-K and amendments to those reports as soon as reasonably practicable after electronically filing or furnishing such material to the SEC. These filings are also accessible on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov.

The Company also will provide without charge a copy of this Report, as well as any documents available on the Company's website, to any shareholder by mail. Requests should be sent to Live Oak Bancshares, Inc., Attention: Corporate Secretary, 1741 Tiburon Drive, Wilmington, NC 28403.

The Company operates on the fundamental philosophy that people are our most valuable asset, because every person who works for us has the potential to impact our success as well as the success of our customers. The Company's employees are the source of our deep industry and product expertise and the embodiment of our culture. It is this industry vertical expertise, product knowledge and our culture that differentiate the Company and allow us to provide an unprecedented customer service and live our mission to fuel the growth of small business across the country and be America's Small Business Bank.

As a financial institution, our ability to attract, develop and retain highly qualified employees is critical to our success. The Company's core values of innovation, dedication, ownership, respect and teamwork are pillars of our culture and represent the expectations we have of each and every one of our employees. We believe our people provide significant value to our Company and its shareholders.

As of December 31, 2025, the Company had 1,027 full-time employees, 13 part-time employees and 37 independent contractors. None of the Company's employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement, and management considers relations with employees to be good.

The Company strives to foster a welcoming, supportive, and equitable environment for all employees. To accomplish this, the Company focuses on engagement, awareness, training, accountability, education, and communication. During 2025, the Company continued to support programming through its Employee Resource Groups ("ERG") and interest groups. These employee-led networks, which are voluntary and open to all employees, provide community and connection through shared interests and experiences. The Company's human capital initiatives are both internally and externally focused. The Company and ERG leadership and membership remain committed to celebrating and supporting a wide variety of locally owned small businesses through on-campus events that showcase a broad range of entrepreneurs in the surrounding communities. Our commitment to providing and enhancing a support infrastructure for people of all backgrounds remains a strategic initiative. The Company intends to continue to identify, monitor and measure meaningful equal opportunity goals, to foster a welcoming environment through education, communication and recruiting efforts, and to provide support so that all employees have the resources and relationships they need to be successful and thrive.

We believe that creating an unprecedented banking experience for small business owners nationwide through service and technology will build long-term shareholder value. To accomplish this, we endeavor to identify, recruit, retain and incentivize exceptional employees. Our compensation program is based on the premise that employees should receive fair and equitable treatment based on their individual contributions to the Company's profitability and success. We use a combination of fixed and incentive pay, including base salary, cash bonus, and equity compensation. We also offer a 401(k) savings plan to qualifying employees.

Our compensation program is intended to motivate employees to successfully execute our mission. The Company believes that the most effective incentive compensation programs strive to achieve the following objectives:
•align compensation with responsibilities and performance; •align employees' interests with those of our shareholders;

headings: We may experience increased delinquencies and credit losses, which could have a material adverse effect on our capital, financial condition, and results of operations.
A prolonged U.S. government shutdown or default by the U.S. on government obligations would harm our results of operations.
Pandemics, natural disasters (including hurricanes), global climate change, acts of terrorism, social unrest, and global conflicts may have a negative impact on our business and operations.
The deployment and use of artificial intelligence presents risks and challenges that may adversely impact our business.
We face risks related to the restatement of our financial statements.
The fair value of our investment securities can fluctuate due to factors outside of our control.
Our ACL may prove to be insufficient to absorb lifetime losses on loans, leases and off-balance sheet credit exposures.
The valuation of our loans measured at fair value is based on estimates and subject to fluctuation based on market conditions and other factors that are beyond our control.
The valuation of our servicing rights is based on estimates and subject to fluctuation based on market conditions and other factors that are beyond our control.
The recognition of gains on the sale of loans reflects certain assumptions.
Our rental equipment is subject to residual value risk upon disposition, and may not sell at the prices or in the quantities we expect.
We are subject to liquidity risk in our operations.
Changes in the interest rate environment could reduce our net interest income, which could reduce our profitability.
The amount of other real estate owned, or OREO, may increase significantly, resulting in additional losses, costs and expenses that will negatively affect our operations.
We are subject to environmental liability risk associated with our lending activities.

Our use of appraisals in deciding whether to make a loan secured by real property or how to value the loan in the future may not accurately reflect the net value of the collateral that we can realize.
We could be subject to losses, regulatory action or reputational harm due to fraudulent and negligent acts on the part of loan applicants, our borrowers, our employees and vendors.
New lines of business or new products and services may subject us to additional risks.
We are subject to risk in connection with our strategic activities, including acquisitions, joint ventures, partnerships, and investments.
Our investments in financial technology companies and initiatives subject us to material financial, reputational and strategic risks.
Our investments in other companies may be illiquid.
Our investments and/or financings in certain tax-advantaged projects may not generate returns as anticipated and may have an adverse impact on our financial results.
paragraphs: An investment in Live Oak Bancshares, Inc.'s securities involves certain risks. The following discussion highlights the risks that management believes are material for the Company, but do not necessarily include all the risks that we may face. Additional risks and uncertainties that are not currently known or that management does not currently deem material could also have a material adverse impact on our business, results of our operations and financial condition. You should carefully consider the risk factors and uncertainties described below and elsewhere in this Report in evaluating an investment in Live Oak Bancshares, Inc.'s securities.

The following is a summary of the most significant risks and uncertainties that we believe could adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. In addition to the following summary, you should consider the other information set forth in this "Risk Factors" section and the other information contained in this Report before investing in our securities.
•Increased delinquencies and credit losses could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.

•Changes to the SBA or other government-guaranteed lending programs by the federal government, or the loss of our status as an SBA Preferred Lender, could have a material adverse effect on our business.
•A prolonged U.S. government shutdown or default by the U.S. on government obligations would harm our results of operations.
•Our deployment and use of artificial intelligence presents risks and challenges that may adversely impact our business.

Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. (collectively with its subsidiaries including Live Oak Banking Company, the "Company") is a financial holding company and a bank holding company headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina, incorporated under the laws of North Carolina in December 2008. The Company conducts business operations primarily through its commercial bank subsidiary, Live Oak Banking Company (the "Bank"). The Bank was incorporated in February 2008 as a North Carolina-chartered commercial bank. The Bank specializes in providing lending and deposit-related services to small businesses nationwide. A significant portion of the loans originated by the Bank are partially guaranteed by the U.S. Small Business Administration ("SBA") under the 7(a) Loan program and the U.S. Department of Agriculture ("USDA") Rural Energy for America Program ("REAP"), Water and Environmental Program ("WEP"), Business & Industry ("B&I") and Community Facilities loan programs. These loans are to small businesses and professionals with what the Bank believes are lower risk characteristics. Industries, or "verticals," on which the Bank focuses its lending efforts are carefully selected. The Bank also lends more broadly to select borrowers outside of those verticals.

As of December 31, 2025, the Company's wholly owned material subsidiaries were the Bank, Government Loan Solutions ("GLS"), Live Oak Grove, LLC ("Grove") and Live Oak Ventures, Inc. ("Live Oak Ventures"). GLS is a management and technology consulting firm that advises and offers solutions and services to participants in the government guaranteed lending sector. GLS primarily provides services in connection with the settlement, accounting, and securitization processes for government guaranteed loans, including loans originated under the SBA 7(a) loan programs and USDA guaranteed loans. The Grove provides Company employees and business visitors with on-site dining at the Company's Wilmington, North Carolina headquarters. Live Oak Ventures' purpose is investing in businesses that align with the Company's strategic initiative to be a leader in financial technology. Canapi Advisors, LLC ("Canapi Advisors") was a wholly owned subsidiary providing investment advisory services to a series of funds (the "Canapi Funds") focused on providing venture capital to new and emerging financial technology companies. During the third quarter of 2024, the Canapi Funds were restructured and Canapi Advisors voluntarily withdrew as an investment advisor to the funds. Canapi Advisors was subsequently dissolved in the fourth quarter of 2024. During the fourth quarter of 2024, Live Oak Ventures consolidated its investment in Synply, Inc. as a result of its controlling interest in that entity. Synply is a cloud-based technology platform designed to simplify the loan syndication process for financial institutions. The non-controlling interest in Synply is disclosed according to the Company's consolidation policy.

As of December 31, 2025, the Bank's wholly owned subsidiaries were Live Oak Number One, Inc., Live Oak Clean Energy Financing LLC ("LOCEF"), Live Oak Private Wealth, LLC ("Live Oak Private Wealth") and Tiburon Land Holdings, LLC ("TLH"). Live Oak Number One, Inc. holds properties foreclosed on by the Bank. LOCEF provides financing to entities for renewable energy applications. Live Oak Private Wealth provides high-net-worth individuals and families with strategic wealth and investment management services. TLH holds land adjacent to the Bank's headquarters consisting of wetlands and other protected property for the use and enjoyment of the Bank's employees and customers.

The Company generates revenue primarily from net interest income and secondarily through the origination and sale of government guaranteed loans. Income from the retention of loans consists principally of interest income. Income from the sale of loans is comprised of loan servicing revenue and revaluation of related servicing assets along with net gains on sales of loans. Offsetting these revenues are the cost of funding sources, provision for credit losses, any costs related to foreclosed assets and other operating costs such as salaries and employee benefits, travel, professional services, advertising and marketing and tax expense. The Company also has less routinely generated gains and losses arising from its financial technology investments.

paragraphs: Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. (個別而言，"Bancshares"，合併其子公司包括 Live Oak Banking Company，稱為 "Company"，也稱為 "our" 和 "we")，總部位於北卡羅來納州威明頓市，是 Live Oak Banking Company ("Bank" 或 "Live Oak Bank") 的銀行控股公司。Bank 於 2008 年 2 月成立為北卡羅來納州註冊的商業銀行，並運作一個已建立的全國性線上平台，專門為小企業貸款與存款集資。Bancshares 於 2008 年 12 月 18 日根據北卡羅來納州法律成立，目的是作為 Live Oak Bank 的銀行控股公司。Bancshares 於 2015 年 7 月完成首次公開發行 ("IPO")。

本公司主要發放貸款，部分由美國小企業管理局 ("SBA") 保證，並在較小程度上由美國農業部 ("USDA") 的農村能源美國計畫 ("REAP")、水與環境計畫 ("WEP")、企業與產業 ("B&I") 與社區設施貸款計畫提供保證。這些貸款是針對小企業與專業人士，本公司認為其風險特質較低。本公司專注於特定產業或 "垂直領域" 的貸款業務，並經過仔細選擇。本公司也對這些垂直領域之外的特定借款人提供較廣泛的貸款。

除了專注於產業垂直領域，本公司亦強調發展對客戶業務的詳細瞭解。這種瞭解部分透過虛擬或實際訪問客戶，無論他們位於何處來建立。這些定期訪問旨在為本公司與客戶創造深層且個性化的體驗，貫穿貸款關係。本公司已開發並持續改善一個以科技為基礎的平台，以協助為全國小企業提供財務服務，並運用此科技優化貸款發放流程、客戶體驗、報告指標與貸款後服務活動。本公司在貸款過程各階段高效服務客戶，並透過科技平台監控其表現，而無需維持傳統分行據點。
如需更多關於本公司業務、財務表現與營運成果的資訊，請參閱本報告第二部分，第 7 項 "管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析" 中的 "Overview" 和 "Executive Summary"。

本公司之投票普通股於紐約證券交易所 LLC（簡稱 "NYSE"）以符號 "LOB" 進行交易。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，本公司投票普通股之記名持有人數為 200 人。本公司之託管股份，每份代表 8.375% 固定利率系列 A 累積永續優先股（無面額）之 1/40 分，於紐約證券交易所以符號 "LOB/PA" 進行交易。本公司主要營業處所位於 1741 Tiburon Drive, Wilmington, North Carolina 28403，電話號碼為 (910) 790-5867。本公司維護網站於 www.liveoak.bank。網站上可供查閱之文件包括：(i) 本公司之倫理準則與利益衝突政策；(ii) 董事會審計、風險、薪酬及提名與企業治理委員會章程，以及 (iii) 本公司之企業治理指引。這些文件亦可應股東之請求以紙本形式提供。除非另有明確說明，否則本網站或透過本網站超連結所提供之資訊並非本報告之一部分，亦未納入本報告或本公司向美國證券交易委員會所提交或提供之任何其他文件。
此外，本公司網站提供免費取得年度報告 10-K、季報 10-Q、現況報告 8-K 及這些報告的修正案，於電子提交或提供給 SEC 後盡速提供。這些文件亦可在 SEC 網站 www.sec.gov 取得。
本公司亦將免費提供本報告以及網站上可取得的任何文件，供股東郵寄索取。請寄送至 Live Oak Bancshares, Inc.，寄件至：公司祕書，地址為 1741 Tiburon Drive, Wilmington, NC 28403。
本公司運作的基本哲學是：人是我們最寶貴的資產，因為每位為我們工作的人都有潛力影響我們的成功以及客戶的成功。本公司員工是我們產業與產品專業知識的來源，也是我們文化的體現。正是這種產業垂直領域的專業知識、產品知識與我們的文化，使本公司得以提供前所未有的客戶服務，並實現我們的使命，即推動美國全國小企業的成長，成為美國的小企業銀行。
作為一個金融機構，我們吸引、培養並留住高素質員工的能力對我們的成功至關重要。本公司創新、 dedication、 ownership、 respect 和 teamwork 的核心價值觀是我們文化的重要支柱，並代表了我們對每一位員工的期待。我們相信本公司員工為本公司及其股東提供了重要的價值。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司共有 1,027 名全職員工、13 名兼職員工及 37 名獨立承包商。本公司員工均未參與集體談判協議，且管理層認為與員工的關係良好。

本公司致力於營造一個歡迎、支持且公平的環境，以服務所有員工。為達成此目標，本公司著重於參與、意識、培訓、責任、教育及溝通。在 2025 年，本公司持續透過其員工資源羣組（"ERG"）及興趣羣組支持相關活動。這些由員工主導的網路為自願性且對所有員工開放，透過共享的興趣與經驗提供社羣與連結。本公司的人力資本計畫同時著重於內部與外部。本公司與 ERG 的領導層及成員持續致力於慶祝並支持當地所有小型企業，透過校園活動展示周遭社區廣泛的創業者。本公司對提供並增強支持基礎設施以服務所有背景人士的承諾，仍為一項戰略計畫。本公司意圖持續識別、監測並衡量有意義的平等機會目標，以透過教育、溝通及招募努力營造歡迎的環境，並提供支持，使所有員工擁有實現成功與成長所需的資源與人際關係。
我們相信透過服務與科技，為全國小型企業主創造前所未有的銀行體驗，將能建立長期股東價值。為達成此目標，我們致力於識別、招募、留住並激勵卓越人才。我們的薪酬計畫基於員工應根據其對本公司利潤與成功所做出的個人貢獻，獲得公平且合理的待遇。我們採用固定與激勵性薪酬的組合，包括基本工資、現金獎金及股票薪酬。我們也為符合資格的員工提供 401(k) 儲蓄計畫。
我們的薪酬計畫旨在激勵員工成功執行我們的使命。本公司認為最有效的激勵性薪酬計畫應致力達成以下目標：
•將薪酬與責任與績效對齊；•將員工的利益與本公司股東的利益對齊；

paragraphs: 以下為管理層對話與分析（"MD&A"）之內容，說明對本公司財務狀況及營運成果有重大影響的因素，比較2025年12月31日財務狀況與2024年12月31日之情形。如需比較2024年與2023年結果及其他2023年資訊，請參閱2024年Form 10-K/A申報文件中Part II, Item 7之"Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations"，該文件於2025年11月17日提交至SEC。此討論應與本年度Form 10-K申報文件中其他處所列之財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。本審查所包含期間之營運結果，未必能代表未來任何期間之結果。
表格中之金額以千美元為單位表示，除每股金額外。

Live Oak Bancshares, Inc.（與其子公司包括Live Oak Banking Company合稱為"本公司"）為一財務控股公司及銀行控股公司，總部設於北卡羅來納州威明頓市，於2008年12月根據北卡羅來納州法律設立。本公司主要透過其商業銀行子公司Live Oak Banking Company（"銀行"）進行業務營運。該銀行於2008年2月設立為北卡羅來納州核准之商業銀行。該銀行專門為全國小型企業提供貸款及存款相關服務。該銀行所發放之貸款中，有相當大比例為美國小企業管理局（"SBA"）根據7(a)貸款計畫及美國農業部（"USDA"）農村能源為美國計畫（"REAP"）、水與環境計畫（"WEP"）、企業與產業（"B&I"）及社區設施貸款計畫所部分擔保。這些貸款針對小型企業及專業人士，該銀行認為其風險特質較低。該銀行所專注之產業，或稱為"垂直領域"，均經過仔細選擇。該銀行也對那些垂直領域之外之特定借款人提供較廣泛之貸款。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司之 wholly owned 重要子公司為銀行、政府貸款解決方案（"GLS"）、Live Oak Grove, LLC（"Grove"）及Live Oak Ventures, Inc.（"Live Oak Ventures"）。GLS為一管理與科技諮詢公司，為參與政府擔保貸款領域之參與者提供諮詢及解決方案與服務。GLS主要提供與政府擔保貸款之結清、會計及證券化程序相關之服務，包括根據SBA 7(a)貸款計畫及USDA擔保貸款所發放之貸款。Grove為本公司威明頓市北卡羅來納州總部之員工及商業訪客提供現場餐飲服務。Live Oak Ventures之目標為投資與本公司戰略計畫成為金融科技領導者相符之企業。Canapi Advisors, LLC（"Canapi Advisors"）為一 wholly owned 子公司，為一系列基金（"Canapi Funds"）提供投資顧問服務，這些基金專注於為新興金融科技公司提供風險投資。於2024年第三季，Canapi Funds進行重組，Canapi Advisors自願退出作為這些基金之投資顧問。Canapi Advisors於2024年第四季解散。於2024年第四季，Live Oak Ventures將其對Synply, Inc.之投資合併，因其對該實體擁有控制權。Synply為一基於雲端之科技平台，旨在簡化金融機構之貸款 syndication 程序。Synply 之非控制性權益根據本公司之合併政策進行披露。

截至2025年12月31日，銀行之 wholly owned 子公司為Live Oak Number One, Inc.、Live Oak Clean Energy Financing LLC（"LOCEF"）、Live Oak Private Wealth, LLC（"Live Oak Private Wealth"）及Tiburon Land Holdings, LLC（"TLH"）。Live Oak Number One, Inc.持有銀行所沒收之不動產。LOCEF為企業提供可再生能源應用之融資。Live Oak Private Wealth為高淨值個人及家庭提供戰略財富與投資管理服務。TLH持有位於銀行總部附近之土地，包含濕地及其他受保護之不動產，供銀行員工及客戶使用與享受。
本公司之收入主要來自淨利息收入，其次為政府擔保貸款之發放與銷售。來自貸款保留之收入主要為利息收入。來自貸款銷售之收入包含貸款服務收入及相關服務資產之重新評價，以及貸款銷售之淨收益。抵銷這些收入之費用包括資金來源成本、信貸減損準備、與沒收資產相關之費用及其他營運費用，如薪資及員工福利、差旅、專業服務、廣告與行銷及稅務費用。本公司亦有較少見之金融科技投資所產生之收益與損失。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們可能面臨增加的違約與信用損失，這可能會對我們的資本、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
美國政府長時間停擺或美國未能履行政府債務義務，將會損害我們的營運成果。
疫情、天然災害（包括颶風）、全球氣候變遷、恐怖攻擊、社會動盪及全球衝突可能對我們的業務與營運產生負面影響。
人工智慧的部署與應用可能帶來風險與挑戰，這些可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們面臨與財務報表重編相關的風險。
我們的投資證券公允價值可能因我們無法控制的因素而波動。
本公司 ACL 可能無法足夠吸收貸款、租賃及表外信用風險所導致的終身損失。
本公司貸款按公允價值計量的評價係基於估計，並會因市場條件及其他我們無法控制的因素而波動。
本公司服務權的評價係基於估計，並會因市場條件及其他我們無法控制的因素而波動。
貸款出售所認列的獲利反映某些假設。
本公司租賃設備在處分時可能面臨殘值風險，並可能無法以預期的價格或數量出售。
本公司營運面面臨流動性風險。
利率環境的變化可能降低本公司淨利息收入，進而降低本公司獲利能力。
其他實質不動產所有權，或稱 OREO，的數量可能大幅增加，導致額外的損失、成本及費用，將對本公司營運產生負面影響。
本公司受貸款業務活動所衍生之環境責任風險影響。
本公司在決定是否提供以不動產為擔保之貸款或未來評估貸款價值時，使用評價結果，可能無法準確反映本公司所能實現之擔保品淨價值。
本公司可能因貸款申請人、借款人、員工及供應商之詐欺或過失行為，而遭受損失、監管行動或聲譽損害。
新業務線或新產品與服務可能使本公司面臨額外風險。
本公司因戰略活動，包括收購、合資企業、合作夥伴關係及投資，而面臨風險。
本公司對金融科技公司及相關計畫之投資，使本公司面臨重大財務、聲譽及戰略風險。
本公司對其他公司之投資可能缺乏流動性。
本公司對某些稅務優惠計畫之投資與/或融資，可能無法達成預期回報，並可能對本公司財務結果產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 投資 Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. 的證券涉及某些風險。以下討論強調管理階層認為對本公司具重大影響的風險，但未必包含我們可能面臨的所有風險。目前未知或管理階層認為不具重大影響的其他風險與不確定性，也可能對我們的業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。您在評估投資 Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. 的證券時，應仔細考慮本報告中下列風險因素與不確定性，以及本報告其他部分所描述的內容。
以下為我們認為可能對我們業務、財務狀況或營運結果造成不利影響的最重大風險與不確定性總結。除了以下總結外，您在投資我們證券前，應考慮本報告「風險因素」部分及其他資訊。
• 債務逾期增加與信用損失上升，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運結果造成重大不利影響。
• 聯邦政府對 SBA 或其他政府擔保貸款計畫的變更，或我們失去 SBA 優先貸款人資格，可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
• 美國政府長時間停擺或美國未能履行政府義務，將損害我們的營運結果。
• 我們部署與使用人工智慧的應用，可能帶來風險與挑戰，並對我們的業務造成不利影響。
